reference: User-supplied Clash of Clans map screenshot
common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready transparent PNG environment sprite for a 2D isometric village-building game in Godot.
Style: match the supplied Clash of Clans screenshot as a visual reference only: charming stylized mobile-strategy 3D painted sprites, rounded leafy canopies made of chunky readable leaf masses, natural lime/olive green highlights, deep green shaded foliage, warm brown trunks, warm gray stones. Broad readable forms that hold up when scaled down, modest surface detail. Match the elevated orthographic isometric view of the reference, camera looking down around 40 degrees, ground footprint projected with width-to-height roughly 4:3. Top-left daylight, compact soft shadows toward bottom-right.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha outside the sprite. The asset sits flush on ground, never on a thick diamond tile, floating island, cutaway earth slab or pedestal. Ground patches, if requested, are thin, irregular and taper softly into transparency, no straight geometric boundary. Center the complete sprite with ample transparent padding and keep every branch, leaf, shadow and ground patch inside the frame.
Constraints: exactly one cohesive standalone sprite, no multiple separated variants, no sprite sheet, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no buildings, no game UI, no characters, no props outside the requested vegetation/rocks/shore/path. Asymmetric organic arrangement, no rectangular borders.
